description: This file contains helper functions and setup procedures for testing bitmap functionality in Git repositories. It includes functions for comparing outputs, setting up complex repository histories, and various tests related to bitmap indexing and pack files.

methods.name: test_bitmap_traversal
methods.description: Normalizes and compares bitmap and non-bitmap traversal outputs to ensure consistency.

methods.name: setup_bitmap_history
methods.description: Creates a complex repository history with merges and multiple branches to test bitmap traversal logic.

methods.name: rev_list_tests_head
methods.description: Tests commit counting and enumeration using bitmap indexes on a specified branch.

methods.name: rev_list_tests
methods.description: Runs a series of revision list tests on 'second' and 'other' branches.

methods.name: basic_bitmap_tests
methods.description: Performs basic validation of rev-list, cloning, and object enumeration with bitmaps.

methods.name: have_delta
methods.description: Checks if a Git object is stored as a delta on top of a given base object.

methods.name: midx_pack_source
methods.description: Determines which pack file a specified object is stored in by reading the multi-pack index.

methods.name: test_rev_exists
methods.description: Verifies the existence of a reverse index for a specific commit and revision kind.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_core
methods.description: Creates a multi-pack index with bitmaps, runs various bitmap-related tests, and handles pack creation and cloning.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_partial_tests
methods.description: Sets up partial bitmap packs and tests their correctness with a complex history.
